review.note: Approval was given in chat on the repository owner's instruction (issue onsager-ai/tolmap#219) and recorded by an agent on that instruction.
review.observedDiff: No prior approved references existed, so there was no pixel diff; every candidate in the run had status passed.

recaptures.reason: The first references had timing- and paint-history-dependent pixels: they were captured before district symbols and CodeMirror measurement had settled, with partial-raster patches whose anti-aliased edges differ from a full raster, and with fractional-height CodeMirror lines whose glyph baselines flipped by one pixel between runs. The harness now waits for a quiet page, rasterises whole tiles and uses whole-pixel CodeMirror line boxes for source captures (web/scripts/check-storybook.mjs). The listed references were re-captured from that state; the 580 candidates of two earlier runs of the same code were byte-identical apart from the final fix.
PR #243 adds the approved Tolmap mark beside the tolmap local page heading, which changes every native local-page capture. Approved by the repository owner in chat ("Merge", 2026-11-06).
